items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: He came in with us with this brother show... So the first Washboard band, Jasper Taylor was playing the Washboard.

ctx.x: Yeah. Secretary, arrangers, and he had different people coming in the range, like nobody else. You said he had somebody from his office that once made a record? Yeah, one time we had one of these things, I don't remember,

that's the number of records I've been trying to hear. I don't even understand his name. He was working his office, I don't know what he's done, any kind of office working on the secretary or something. He had a pretty nice voice. So the crime would take everybody, and take them down with Macon Carter. So it's at this point, he went on Thursday. He was saying on the other side his wife, even Taylor was saying. We made that for Bluebird, not Victor, that was a part of Victor. Subsidiar. Yeah. We made that record,…
I'll have to look for it and see if I can find it. It's made around 1931 or 1932.
